title: European SpaceX Rival in Talks to Raise $300 Million, FT Reports
description: The Exploration Company Gmbh, a potential European rival to Elon Musk’s SpaceX, is in talks to raise at least $300 million, in part from the European Union’s Scaleup Europe Fund, bumping the company’s valuation to more than $2 billion, the Financial Times reported.

title: Apple Glasses May Debut at WWDC 2027: Privacy, Camera Features Versus Meta

title: Memory Frenzy Primes China Champion CXMT for Historic Debut
description: Investor excitement over the memory chip trade is setting outsize expectations for the Shanghai debut of CXMT Corp., which is on the brink of making history after a near-record initial public offering.
